headline: A 2-for-4 night
record_line: Yesterday: 2-2 on the top plays · Season: 24-97

entries.headline: Mike Trout stayed in the yard
entries.story: Mike Trout went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Cristian Javier and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Munetaka Murakami connected at +281
entries.story: Munetaka Murakami cashed. Facing Kevin Gausman, he went deep in the 3rd in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Munetaka Murakami homers (29) on a fly ball to left center field." Final line: 1-for-4 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Zach Neto came close
entries.story: Zach Neto went 2-for-4 with 1 RBI against Cristian Javier and the Houston Astros. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Zach Neto doubles (24) on a fly ball to shortstop Jeremy Peña. Nolan Schanuel scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani connected at +201
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani cashed. Facing Ryan Feltner, he went deep in the 3rd in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Shohei Ohtani homers (30) on a fly ball to right center field. Hunter Feduccia scores." Final line: 1-for-5.
